title: ChargePoint to Report Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results on December 3, 2026
body_markdown:
[Campbell, Calif.](https://www.chargepoint.com/) – November 19, 2026


– ChargePoint Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CHPT) (“ChargePoint” or the “Company”), a global leader in intelligent electrification and e-mobility today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027, ended October 31, 2026, after the market closes on Thursday, December 3, 2026.


ChargePoint will host a conference call and webcast to discuss its financial results and business performance on December 3, 2026, at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time (4:30 p.m. Eastern time).


## Conference Call and Webcast Details


- **Date:** Thursday, December 3, 2026
- **Time:** 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time
- **Live Webcast:**[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/932158487](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/932158487)
- **North America Dial-In:** +1 833 461 5787
- **International Dial-In:** +1 585 542 9983
- **Conference ID:** 932 158 487


The live webcast and accompanying financial results press release will be accessible through ChargePoint’s Investor Relations website at[investors.chargepoint.com](https://investors.chargepoint.com/) .


A replay of the webcast will be available following the conclusion of the call and archived on the Company’s Investor Relations website for one year.


## About ChargePoint Holdings, Inc.


ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is an established global leader in intelligent electrification and e-mobility. Since its inception in 2007, long before EVs became widely available, the company has provided comprehensive solutions tailored to the entire EV ecosystem, from the grid to the dashboard of the vehicle. ChargePoint serves EV drivers, charging station owners, vehicle manufacturers, and other key stakeholders. With a commitment to accessibility and reliability, ChargePoint’s extensive portfolio of software, hardware, and services ensures a seamless charging experience for drivers across North America and Europe. ChargePoint empowers every driver in need of charging access, connecting them to almost 1.5 million public and private charging ports worldwide, underscoring its dedication to electrifying the future of transportation. For further information, please visit the ChargePoint pressroom or the ChargePoint Investor Relations site. For media inquiries, contact the ChargePoint press office.
